outcome.spec:
Audit pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/790 (branch cohort/configured-question-evidence/79693b) in repository oakridge. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not feature work: its only purpose is real plan, brief, build_result and assessment artifacts for observation to capture. Produce exactly one cohort, named audit, with two tasks. T1: observation/graders.json is the only grader selection, and startup validates and registers it (observation/src/grading/configuration.ts, observation/src/main.ts). T2: cited files are read at the assessed commit, and a file missing there is recorded as absent (observation/src/producers/oakridge/evidence.ts, observation/src/storage/git-repository-reader.ts).
The operator authorizes this audit path: the builder publishes the existing PR #790 as its pr artifact instead of pushing or opening one. No brief may add a further operator choice or confirmation. The builder must not edit files, create commits, push, open or update any pull request, merge, reset a database or deploy. Its worktree starts from epic/grade-pray, the base of pull request #790, so it first checks out the head of branch cohort/configured-question-evidence/79693b locally (git checkout --detach origin/cohort/configured-question-evidence/79693b) and inspects that commit, runs bun install if needed and then bun run --filter observation test once. A test that cannot run is a known issue, never a reason to invent results. It then publishes the existing pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/790 as the pr artifact first, with branch cohort/configured-question-evidence/79693b and without opening or updating the pull request. It then publishes build_result with the commit it inspected as head_sha and the actual test counts and output.
The assessor assesses that same commit without changing anything. Give at least one finding per task. Every finding cites at least one file as path:start-end at that commit, for example observation/src/main.ts:20-40, and cites test output separately as test or output evidence. Report the builder's test run as test_evidence. This audit overrides the standard draft-state step. After publishing assessment, the assessor must not call set_pr_draft or otherwise update PR #790; without changing anything includes repository, commit, branch, and pull-request state.
Assessment publication for operator review is the terminal boundary of this isolated audit. Leave the cohort awaiting that review; do not confirm merge, complete the cohort, or start the development workflow integration unit.
Keep the analysis, spec, tasks, plan and brief short; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve.

body.summary: The audit is implementable with one cohort named audit and exactly tasks T1 and T2. PR #790 is currently open and draft at cdeba035bf148caf767eeb177905a8351992ed36, based on epic/grade-pray, and the target commit contains direct code and test surfaces for both tasks. No operator decision or implementation blocker is missing. Three short corrections are needed to keep this artifact-only audit aligned with the pinned development workflow: publish pr before build_result, suppress assessor draft-state mutation, and stop before cohort completion can launch integration.

findings.description: T1 is directly assessable at PR head cdeba035bf148caf767eeb177905a8351992ed36: observation/src/grading/configuration.ts:37-49 strictly parses the committed grader configuration and lines 74-87 derive configured evaluators; observation/src/main.ts:17-33 makes graders.json the selection input and validates configuration and credentials, while lines 70-81 load and register definitions during startup. Focused coverage exists in observation/tests/grader-configuration.test.ts:26-53 and observation/tests/grading-startup.test.ts:128-159.

T2 is directly assessable at the same commit: observation/src/producers/oakridge/evidence.ts:71-100 selects the launch repository holding assessment head_sha, reads each cited path at that commit, and emits is_absent true with null content for a missing file. observation/src/storage/git-repository-reader.ts:22-42 uses git cat-file against the exact commit and distinguishes absent from unavailable. Behavioral coverage exists in observation/tests/git-repository-reader.test.ts:42-73 and observation/tests/producer-evidence.test.ts:90-105.

The specification says to publish build_result and then pr, but the pinned builder contract requires pr first and forbids publishing build_result before it at workflow-config/prompts/development/build.md:39-44. This order also ensures the assessor, dispatched from build_result, can resolve latest(pr) as wired in workflow-config/development.yaml:356-362. Reverse the two publication steps; this needs no operator choice.

The audit says the assessor changes nothing, while the pinned assessor contract requires set_pr_draft after assessment at workflow-config/prompts/development/assess.md:43-48. PR #790 is currently draft, so a passing verdict would mutate it to ready. State the audit exception explicitly: the assessor publishes assessment only and does not call set_pr_draft or otherwise update PR #790.

The standard development run creates an integration unit for every repository with a completed implementation outcome at workflow-config/development.yaml:194-203, and its integrator is authorized to create pr and assessment artifacts at workflow-config/development.yaml:404-425. That exceeds this audit-only scope and could lead to edits, commits, pushes, or a new PR. Make assessment publication the terminal audit boundary and leave the cohort awaiting operator review rather than completing it into integration.

requirements.description: Produce exactly one short cohort named audit with exactly two tasks, T1 and T2, and no additional operator choice in the brief.
T1 assesses observation/graders.json as the only grader selection plus startup validation and registration in observation/src/grading/configuration.ts and observation/src/main.ts.

T2 assesses cited files at assessment head_sha and records a path missing from that readable commit as absent in observation/src/producers/oakridge/evidence.ts and observation/src/storage/git-repository-reader.ts.

The builder checks out the local PR head, makes no code or remote changes, runs the observation test command once, reports actual results or a known issue, and republishes existing PR #790; publication order should follow F3.

The assessor reviews build_result.head_sha without repository changes, gives at least one linked finding per task with file and separate test or output evidence, and copies the builder run into test_evidence; PR-state mutation should be suppressed per F4.
The isolated verification ends after the assessment artifact is published for operator review, before normal cohort completion can start integration.
